# SvoCraft

SvoCraft - милитари Minecraft-сервер с ивентовыми событиями, мини-играми, собственным лаунчером и косметикой. The public site introduces the project, explains how to start playing, links to launcher downloads, provides documentation, and routes players to community and support channels.

## Public site map

### Homepage

URL: https://svocraft.xyz/

The homepage presents the SvoCraft server, highlights quick PvP matches and team events, explains Discord authorization, links to the launcher, links to the project wiki, and points players to the shop and community channels.

### Downloads

URL: https://svocraft.xyz/downloads

The downloads page provides launcher builds for supported desktop platforms. Players use the launcher to sign in, download updates, and start the game client without manual setup.

### Wiki

URL: https://svocraft.xyz/wiki/

The wiki contains player documentation. The getting started guide is available at https://svocraft.xyz/wiki/getting-started.html and should be treated as the canonical onboarding document for new players.

### Shop

URL: https://svocraft.xyz/shop

The shop presents cosmetic items and support purchases. Purchases are tied to the player's SvoCraft account and inventory.

### Contacts

URL: https://svocraft.xyz/contacts

The contacts page lists official support and social channels:

- Discord: https://discord.gg/UQQK4ykxMa
- Telegram: https://t.me/sv0craft
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@sv0craft
- Support: https://t.me/svocraft_sup

### Legal documents

URL: https://svocraft.xyz/legal

The legal section includes the public offer, user agreement, privacy policy, refund policy, project rules, community rules, and CTF rules. Use these pages for policy questions instead of inferring rules from marketing copy.

## Private or non-public areas

The following routes require account context or are not meant as public documentation:

- https://svocraft.xyz/profile
- https://svocraft.xyz/inventory
- https://svocraft.xyz/wallet
- https://svocraft.xyz/token
- https://svocraft.xyz/admin
